title: No.1 Rockford Manor, Navan, Co. Meath
seoTitle: No.1 Rockford Manor, Navan, Co. Meath
description:
No.1 Rockford Manor is a beautiful 4 bedroom home with all mod cons 300mts from Bailieborough Main Street,  300mts from Bailieborough school and a few mins walk from town lake to name a few amenities on your doorstep! 45 mins from Blanchardstown/M50 + 25 mins from Navan 1 hour from Belfast  These new homes have to be seen to be appreciated. Homes like these rarely enter the rental market. They are tastefully furnished to a really high standard. All bedrooms have brand new modern floor to ceiling  wardrobes. The kitchen is state of the art and has all modern appliances.

Heating is by way of a modern heat pump system along with a HRU for fresh air and heat recovery. All lighting fixtures are modern and very low energy rated.

Your in the middle of town yet feel like your in the countryside as the back garden looks out onto a lovely farm hill with no homes behind the property so it’s really peaceful and private.

The lawns are maintained by our local garden service agent as part of the tenancy agreement.

Rooms downstairs:
Kitchen
Dining room
Utility room 
Downstairs toilet WC
Downstairs hall, closet under stairs  
Living room

Upstairs rooms:
Stairs, upstairs landing hall 
Front Single bedroom/office
Front master bedroom and en suite 
Main bathroom & shower 
Back Double bedroom 
Back Double bedroom 

Homes must be seen to fully appreciate just how outstanding they are. Thank you for your interest and we look forward to viewing property to any potential tenants.
